modelMarket.title: Model catalog
modelMarket.description: Explore the models and effective prices available to you.
modelMarket.access.title: Your effective access
modelMarket.access.description: Models and prices are calculated from your model groups. Use the model ID in requests and Conduit API will select an available upstream automatically.
modelMarket.filters.placeholder: Search name, model ID, or developer…
modelMarket.sort.name: Name
modelMarket.empty.title: No models are granted to your model groups
modelMarket.empty.description: No model currently passes both your model-group entitlement and available-route restrictions. Contact an administrator to adjust access.
modelMarket.error.title: Model catalog unavailable
modelMarket.error.description: The catalog service could not be loaded. Please retry shortly.
modelMarket.price.effectiveHint: Published default retail prices include the current Project multiplier ×{{multiplier}} and are shown in station credits. Final charges depend on actual usage.
modelMarket.detail.routesHint: Only sanitized routes you can reach are shown; Conduit API routes automatically.
modelMarket.detail.automaticRoutingHint: Send requests with the model ID above. Conduit API selects an available upstream automatically, with no route configuration or selection required.
modelMarket.route.title: Your available upstreams
modelMarket.route.description: A route may cover several entitled models. Internal URLs, credentials, and scheduling weights are never exposed.
modelMarket.route.healthHidden: Upstream health has not been shared by the administrator.
modelMarket.route.emptyDescription: No route is available under your effective access. Ask an administrator to review your model groups and channel status.
modelMarket.price.unavailable: Price unavailable · published price cannot be displayed safely
modelMarket.price.rule.usage_tiered: Each token segment is charged at its own tier rate.
modelMarket.price.rule.usage_volume: The tier matching total token quantity sets the rate for all tokens.
modelMarket.price.itemsHint: Published price components are combined. Fixed fees apply per request; token rates apply to the indicated token class. Item order and repeated components are retained.
modelMarket.price.variantsHint: For cache writes, five_min and one_hour rates apply when usage reports the corresponding lifetime; otherwise the base rate applies. The first matching variant is used; other variant codes are retained as published configuration.
modelMarket.price.structured_one: {{count}} price component · view details for all rates and conditions
modelMarket.price.structured_other: {{count}} price components · view details for all rates and conditions
modelMarket.price.conditionHint: Rules match in order, then the group base or global fallback. Time uses the system timezone frozen at request start; token conditions use actual metered usage. Zero is valid.
modelMarket.price.ruleCount: {{count}} ordered rules · open details for every price
modelMarket.scope.label: Price display scope
modelMarket.scope.select: Select an authorized model group or owned key
modelMarket.scope.hint: This changes the price preview only. Requests always use the model group fixed on their API key. Project adjustment is included once.
